name: Open Local Repo
description: Resolves a name or partial path to a local repo under configured search roots and surfaces the command to open it in the configured editor.

searchRoots.label: Search Roots
searchRoots.description: Comma-separated list of directories under which TPM searches for a matching repo name. First match wins. Add or trim to match your conventions; if all your repos live under one root, set just that one.

fuzzyMatch.label: Fuzzy Match
fuzzyMatch.description: When on, TPM treats the user's input as a partial match against directory basenames (case-insensitive substring). When off, requires an exact basename match. On is the typical default for ergonomic navigation.

openCommand.label: Open Command
openCommand.description: Command TPM surfaces for opening the resolved path. code for VS Code, code-insiders for VS Code Insiders, cursor for the Cursor editor. Set to any command name that accepts a path argument. The command runs in the user's shell after they confirm.

triggerPhrases.label: Trigger Phrases
triggerPhrases.description: Comma-separated list of substring patterns TPM watches for. Matched case-insensitively. Tune to fit phrasing patterns.
triggerPhrases.default: open repo, open in vscode, take me to, open project, switch to repo

onMultipleMatches.label: On Multiple Matches
onMultipleMatches.description: When the fuzzy match returns multiple candidates. ask presents the list and lets the user pick. first silently takes the first match (by search-root order). refuse responds with ambiguous match — be more specific. Default ask is the safest.
